definitions.explanation: money given to someone who is ill, injured, or has suffered a disaster, as a gesture of sympathy and support

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{見舞金|みまいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{入院|にゅういん}した→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見舞金|みまいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}した→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: I gave sympathy money to a colleague who was hospitalized.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被災者|ひさいしゃ}→被災者：25337_hisaisha⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧{十万円|じゅうまんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見舞金|みまいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{支給|しきゅう}→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Disaster relief payments of 100,000 yen per person were provided to the victims.

notes:
Money given as a gesture of sympathy to someone facing illness, injury, or disaster. In Japanese culture, giving money in these situations is a standard social practice, similar to ⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧ (condolence money for funerals) but for living recipients. The amount varies by relationship and situation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見舞金|みまいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧: to hand over sympathy money
- {見舞金|みまいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive sympathy money
- {見舞金|みまいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{支給|しきゅう}→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: sympathy money is provided
- {災害|さいがい}{見舞金|みまいきん}: disaster relief payment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧: condolence money — specifically for funerals
- ⟦{慰謝料|いしゃりょう}→慰謝料：14802_isharyou⟧: compensation for damages — a legal term for monetary compensation for pain and suffering
- ⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧: get-well visit — the visit itself, which may or may not include money
